messages:
erica: Heads-up: staging canary promotion halted by CI when the image unpack step failed on our rootless runners. deploy-bot auto-paused the rollout.
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: job `ci/staging/unpack` failed with "operation not permitted" during tar extraction. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/1769009999
rupert: Paste from the failing job:
```
[2026-03-22T09:12:07Z] unpacking layer 2/6
/usr/bin/tar: ./bin/redwood: Cannot change permissions to 04755: Permission denied
failed to unpack: operation not permitted
```
mina: We switched to a slim base two weeks ago; think this is an interaction with setuid bits and overlayfs on rootless runners (podman). I can reproduce with `podman unshare` locally.
erica: Change window is open. Proposal: temporarily pin base image to last-known-good digest `sha256:abcdef1234` in Dockerfile and trigger a new staging run to unblock. We'll do RCA after release.
ci-bot: Manual config rollback allowed by policy. Promotion will remain blocked until a green CI run and manual approval.
devon: +1 to pin. Please keep the change small and include a one-line explanation referencing the CI log.
rupert: Opening PR now to pin base to `sha256:abcdef1234` and add a CI smoke test that performs a rootless unpack check.
deploy-bot: PR #5601 opened: pin base image -> sha256:abcdef1234. CI triggered.
deploy-bot: CI for PR #5601 completed: status=success (staging unpack succeeded).
erica: Requesting manual promote for release `release-2026-03-22`.
erica: /promote release-2026-03-22 --manual
deploy-bot: Promotion requested. Required approvals: eng-releases (devon), eng-sre (mina).
devon: Approved.
mina: Approved.
deploy-bot: Promotion progressing: 0% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Health checks OK. Promotion complete.
erica: Unblocked. Adding release note: "Temporarily pinned base image due to image unpack permission failures on rootless CI runners; follow-up RCA and fix planned (ticket RW-3783)."
mina: I'll own the RCA and include repro steps (podman rootless) and propose two fixes: strip suid bits during image build, or adjust runner extraction logic to fall back.
devon: Also adding an integration test to CI to catch this class of failure.
rupert: Thanks all for quick turnaround. Closing thread — will update RW-3783 with progress.
